status: frozen before any outcome (price, return or abnormal return) of these events was pulled or computed; changes only in an events-v2 file with reasons
seenBeforeWriting: EDGAR full-index master.gz for 2019 QTR2 (form type counts only: NT 10-K 425, NT 10-Q 498, SC 13D 577, SC 13D/A 1,867, 25-NSE 392; that an SC 13D accession is listed once under the subject company and once under each filer)
efts full-text search hit count and five hit records for the phrase "Item 4.02" in 2019 8-Ks (127 hits; records carry an items field)
the F7 study (docs/f7-study.md, .cache/study/f7-summary.json) and its registered estimate, which set the method and the bar reused here
goal: Falcon's own post-2015 estimate for three own-firm event families the Sightings engine already detects, so a family can earn Documented ('Backed by research') status when, and only when, its measured effect goes the expected way and passes the same bar as F7.

code.events: packages/engine/src/study/filing-events.ts (pure: index parsing, subject company, de-duplication, pass bar)
code.measurement: packages/engine/src/study/abnormal.ts measureEvent and eventStudy, src/study/controls.ts, src/study/stats.ts, unchanged from the F7 study

sample.source: EDGAR full-index master.gz, 2015 QTR1 to 2026 QTR2 (form type, CIK, filing date, accession); for 8-K item 4.02 the EDGAR full-text search (efts) items field; no LLM

F6_late_filing.event: form type exactly "NT 10-K" or "NT 10-Q" (Form 12b-25). Amendments (/A), NT 20-F, NT 11-K and fund forms are excluded. Issuer = the filing CIK.
F6_late_filing.dedupe: per issuer, filings in date order; a filing within 30 calendar days of that issuer's previous kept event is a duplicate (same period re-filed, or the 10-K and 10-Q notices of one episode)
F6_late_filing.detectorMatch: src/detectors/distress.ts distressNtDetector: same forms (NT 20-F left out per this study's scope: the universe is US-listed common stock), issuer must be US-listed, no LLM, sign -1. The detector itself does not de-duplicate; the study does so that one episode counts once.

F8_activist_stake.event: form type exactly "SC 13D" or "SCHEDULE 13D" (initial Schedule 13D; "/A" amendments excluded) where the filer is not the issuer: the accession must list at least two CIKs in the index; the subject company is the one CIK with a row in company_tickers_exchange.json; when several do, the SEC header's SUBJECT COMPANY decides; an accession whose only CIK is the subject (self-filed) is dropped.
F8_activist_stake.dedupe: per subject company, one event per 30 calendar days (group members filing separately count once)
F8_activist_stake.detectorMatch: src/detectors/activist.ts keeps only 13Ds whose Item 4 Haiku labels as activist (board seats, strategy change, sale push, capital return, acquisition proposal). That label needs an LLM and the document text; it is not applied here. The study therefore measures all initial third-party 13Ds, a broader population than the cards (it includes founders, strategic holders and passive 13D filers). Reported as a caveat; the verdict applies to this broader population.

F6_restatement_402.event: form type exactly "8-K" (8-K/A excluded) whose EDGAR items include 4.02 (non-reliance on previously issued financial statements). Found with efts full-text search per calendar year for the phrases "Item 4.02" and "non-reliance" (union), kept only when the record's items field contains 4.02. Issuer = the first CIK of the record.
F6_restatement_402.dedupe: per issuer, one event per 30 calendar days
F6_restatement_402.detectorMatch: src/detectors/distress.ts restatementDetector: same route (8-K with item 4.02, US-listed). The detector's Haiku read only drops filings the model says are not a non-reliance notice and adds scope facts; it is not applied. Blank-check companies (SIC 6770, the 2021 SPAC warrant restatements) are kept in the primary sample, as the detector keeps them; a secondary excludes them.

universe.rule: the same gate as F7, at the event date: the issuer CIK maps to a ticker (company_tickers_exchange.json, the F7 study's copy of 2026-11-14), Yahoo has its daily history covering day 0 and the estimation window, unadjusted price > $5 at the last close before day 0 (split-adjusted close times later split ratios), 20-session median dollar volume >= $5M before day 0, and >= 120 valid estimation days. Common-stock-like primary ticker per CIK (regex ^[A-Z]{1,5}(-[A-Z])?$, first listed class).
universe.listedNow: ticker on Nasdaq, NYSE or Cboe today (as F7)
universe.delistedWherePricesExist: survivorship extension beyond F7: a CIK whose ticker today is on OTC or has no exchange is kept when the same CIK has a Form 25 or 25-NSE in the full index filed after the event date (it was exchange-listed at the event and delisted later) and Yahoo still serves the symbol's history. Reported separately; the primary pools both groups.
universe.survivorshipReport: funnel per family: events, issuers with no ticker today (gone: acquired, deregistered or renamed beyond reach), listed today, delisted-but-priced, no Yahoo, price and volume gates, measured

timing.publicTime: EDGAR acceptance instant from the filing's -index.htm 'Accepted' line; when unreadable, 16:01 New York on the filing date (can only make entry later)
timing.entry: first regular-session open strictly after the public time (abnormal.ts entryIndex, latency 0)
timing.day0: first session whose close is after the public time

outcomes.primary: beta x SPY abnormal return over L = 20 sessions from the tradable entry: sum over sessions t0 .. t0+19 of r_i - beta_i r_SPY (first session open-to-close), beta from the SPY market model on sessions [-260, -11] relative to day 0; percent. This is the F7 registered column (CAR + alpha L).
secondary: market-model CAR (with the estimation alpha) at L = 20 and 5
raw return minus SPY at L = 20
matched-control outcome y (src/study/controls.ts, as F7: 3-5 same-date controls by SIC, size, beta; y = sign x (SCAR_hit - mean SCAR_controls), winsorized at 3) at L = 20
PRE: last close before the public time to the entry open (already happened at entry; descriptive)
by period (development, validation, holdout), by listing status (listed now, delisted but priced), and for 4.02 excluding SIC 6770

inference.clustering: eventStudy: t clustered by event date (df G - 1) and two-way by issuer x calendar month (Cameron-Gelbach-Miller, df min(G) - 1); wild-cluster bootstrap p when G < 30
inference.pValues: one-sided in the family's expected direction (H1: mean < 0 for expectedSign -1, mean > 0 for +1)

passBar.sameAs: F7's registered estimate: conservative beta x SPY column, L = 20, one-sided p from the two-way clustered t below 0.05 (F7: mean +0.96%, t 2.22, p 0.014)
rules: primary mean has the expected sign
one-sided p < 0.05 in the expected direction from the two-way (issuer x month) clustered t
one-sided p < 0.05 in the expected direction from the date-clustered t
passBar.multipleTesting: three families, each judged on its own bar as F7 was; a Bonferroni reading (p < 0.0167) is reported beside it, not used to decide
passBar.consequence: a family that passes gets an ownEstimate in data/evidence-registry.json with the primary column's numbers as computed (period, n, nEvents = distinct event dates, windowDays 20, meanAbnPct, medianAbnPct, tStat = two-way t, p = one-sided two-way p, benchmark beta_x_spy, computedAt, note). A family that fails gets none and stays Watch.
